Without the specific list of authorised claims and their permitted wording, it is not possible to determine from the retrieved clauses whether the claim as worded is compliant or overstated. There is also no evidence in the retrieved clauses regarding the prohibition of disease prevention, treatment, or cure claims, though the claim in question does not appear to make such a statement.
